name: HR - Employees Read

parameters.query:
SET search_path TO "tenant_d5c2f6ec_9dbf_49b3_ab8d_c431043972f6";
SELECT e.id, e.employee_code, e.full_name, d.name as department_name, e.position, e.status FROM hr_employees e LEFT JOIN hr_departments d ON e.department_id = d.id;
